design_intent: Identical to EASY-002 except the day ends at 15:10. The visits total 270 min and the shortest loop through all four POIs walks 110 min, so whatever the order, the earliest return is 09:00 + 270 + 110 = 15:20, 10 min late (the worst order returns at 16:35). No single POI is the problem: proving infeasibility needs a bound over every order, not a check of one POI.
